definition: A model that processes and connects more than one modality, most commonly text and images.
details: Multimodal models learn a shared representation space so that concepts can be transferred across senses — for example, matching an image to a caption that describes it. CLIP trained image and text encoders on 400 million image–text pairs using contrastive learning, enabling zero-shot image classification and powering later generation pipelines.

citation.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
